label: L=3, first copy step after <DEL> when the next output is b (too sparse)
explanation: Active on only 3 dev steps, all with nearly the same activation (~0.105). Each one is in an L=3 sequence at t=4, the first copy step after <DEL> (recall_idx=1), where the output is b (the 2nd original token), and the input is the first token (b or w). The predicate gets full recall but very low precision, and with so few activations no description can be trusted.
